title: Persuasive Visualization of World Bank Data
description: A visualization aimed at honing in and reflecting on data visualization as it pertains to persuasion, and the techniques, deceptive or earnest, required to make such visualizations!

title: Titanic Dataset Class Composition Survival EDA
description: A visualization aimed at understanding the benchmark 'Titanic' dataset in further detail, and running effective survival predictions based on demographic and socioeconomic data

title: Food.com Five Star Prediction Model Fairness Analysis
description: A visualization aimed to test and convey the effective fairness of a hypertuned Recipe 5-Star Prediction model by subsetting data between older and newer recipes
